meta.title: Artifact timeline
meta.description: Adds an Artifact timeline entry to the left sidebar that lists every file produced across all conversations in one time-ordered feed, newest first. It collects three signals from the session logs: the present tool's declared deliverables, successful write/edit and Univer-export calls, and Office documents (docx, pptx, xlsx, pdf, doc) a shell command produced — confirmed by the file existing with a timestamp at or after that command. Green means the file is still on disk unchanged, amber means it was written again after production, and red means a declared or written artifact is gone. Hovering a row reveals its actions: open it on the desktop, reveal it in the file manager, copy its path, or jump to the conversation that produced it — that jump also scrolls the line that mentions the file into view and opens the file in the right sidebar preview, which renders Markdown, HTML, PDF, images, Office documents, spreadsheets and plain text. The toolbar filters by state and searches name, path, and conversation title. Reads only the conversation logs plus a file check; opening only ever touches paths already derived from those logs. It never writes, moves, or deletes anything.
